title: A scientific result is verified only on evidence that supports it, at the store
note: The admission policy for kind scientific_result, in qta_agent/result_rules.py, enforced by AuthorityStore.transition on the edges into VERIFIED and PROMOTED. RR1, RR2, RR3, RR5 and RR6 are ST11, ST10, ST17, ST13 and ST14 of scientific_thermal_1d, moved here with the rule they test. RR8-RR11 re-anchored when the content rule became policy scientific_result.admission/1; RR11 now breaks the store's refusal of an undecidable claim, since the old anchor became an equivalent mutant (an absent fetch is itself unreadable evidence). Origin, replay and the second reader are scientific_authority_replay.json.

mutations.name: RR1_the_report_may_be_about_another_bundle
mutations.rationale: a report about a different bundle verifies this one (was ST11)

mutations.name: RR2_the_verdict_is_not_read
mutations.rationale: a FAIL report verifies the result (was ST10)

mutations.name: RR3_any_report_type_will_do
mutations.rationale: an invariant report stands in for an independent check (was ST17)

mutations.name: RR4_the_producer_is_not_matched
mutations.rationale: a report naming another producer is accepted

mutations.name: RR5_the_producers_code_may_check_itself
mutations.find: if not is_digest(verifier) or verifier == producer:

mutations.name: RR6_the_invariants_are_not_read
mutations.rationale: a bundle that failed its own invariants is verified (was ST14)

mutations.name: RR7_no_invariants_counts_as_all_holding
mutations.rationale: an empty invariant list reads as every invariant holding

mutations.name: RR8_unreadable_evidence_passes
mutations.rationale: evidence nobody could read is taken as support

mutations.name: RR9_a_missing_citation_passes
mutations.find:
if docs[key] is None:
            return [f"the record cites no {key}"]
mutations.rationale: a record citing no bundle is verified

mutations.name: RR10_the_store_never_asks
mutations.rationale: THE bypass: the edge checks only that the report exists

mutations.name: RR11_a_store_without_evidence_verifies
mutations.rationale: a claim this store cannot read -- no evidence store, or no view of governed execution -- is verified anyway

mutations.name: RR12_promotion_is_not_held_to_the_rule
mutations.find:
if cur.kind == result_rules.KIND and dst in (State.VERIFIED,
                                                         State.PROMOTED):
mutations.replace:
if cur.kind == result_rules.KIND and dst in (State.VERIFIED,
                                                         State.VERIFIED):
mutations.rationale: a promotion citing a failing report goes through

mutations.name: RR13_the_rule_applies_to_every_kind
mutations.find: if cur.kind == result_rules.KIND and dst in
mutations.rationale: a rule for scientific results imposed on every record

mutations.name: RR14_experimental_validation_is_admitted
mutations.rationale: a numerical check is admitted as establishing experimental validation

mutations.name: RR15_no_independence_is_independent
mutations.rationale: a check declaring independence NONE counts as independent

mutations.name: RR16_an_observation_is_admitted_as_a_simulation
mutations.rationale: numerical verification admits a processed observation

mutations.name: RR17_the_report_shape_is_not_held
mutations.rationale: a report carrying fields no VerificationResult writes is read as one
